protocol.states_point_in_time: funding percentile: 8h-equivalent rate ranked in trailing-365d event window, computed with data stamped <= decision-bar close; rv percentile: 168h realized vol ranked in trailing-365d; validity >=300 funding events / >=1000 rv readings; funding age <=3 bars
protocol.decision_grid: hourly bar closing 00/08/16 UTC; non-overlapping 8h; outcomes over next 8h and 24h
protocol.execution: next-bar (position applies to the 8 hourly bars after the decision close)

benchmarks.carry_variants: UNCOND-CARRY (always-on long carry strip, zero turnover)

protocol.gate: per-variant predeclared: n >= minimum, Welch t vs mid bucket (0.15<f_pctl<0.85) beyond |3.0| in the predeclared direction, 95% CI of diff excluding zero on that side, symbol sign-consistency (BTC and ETH t of matching sign)
protocol.selection_rule_frozen: first passing variant in priority [V2,V3,V7,V4,V1,V8,V5,V6] with dev net Sharpe > benchmark dev Sharpe and dev cum net >= 0

selection_reasons: V2: gate-fail short_leg f_pctl>=0.99&rv>=0.40 n=61(<80) t=+2.43 (positive = opposite of predeclared negative)
V3: gate-fail short_leg persistent-tail n=12(<60) t=+2.67 (positive)
V7: gate-fail short_leg confluence n=48(<50) t=+1.96 (positive)
V4: gate-fail short_leg high-vol tail n=42(<60) t=+1.61 (positive)
V1: gate-fail short_leg f_pctl>=0.99 n=69(<80) t=+2.68 (positive); long leg informational t=-4.60 (opposite sign)
V8: gate-fail short_leg perp8 n=61(<80) t=+0.96 (ambiguous)
V5: gate-fail long_leg n=6(<60) t=-1.91 (unstable, near-empty cell)

variants.name: PCT-TAILS
variants.rule: pos=-1 if f_pctl>=0.99; +1 if f_pctl<=0.15; else 0
variants.falsification: extreme funding tail did not precede carry drawdown; it preceded carry outperformance

variants.name: VOL-BOTH
variants.rule: if rv_pctl>=0.40: pos=-1 if f_pctl>=0.99; +1 if f_pctl<=0.15; else 0; else 0
variants.falsification: tail carry t=+2.43 in the rv>=0.40 regime (opposite sign), n=61<80

variants.name: PERSISTENT-TAIL
variants.rule: pos=-1 if f_pctl>=0.99 & f_pctl_prev>=0.99 & rv_pctl<0.60; else 0
variants.falsification: persistent-tail cell too small (n=12<60); sign positive (t=+2.67), opposite of predeclared

variants.name: VOL-CARRY
variants.rule: pos=-1 if f_pctl>=0.99 & rv_pctl>=0.60; +1 if f_pctl<=0.01 & rv_pctl<=0.40; else 0
variants.falsification: high-vol tail t=+1.61 (opposite), n=42<60; long leg informational sign also opposite

variants.name: LOW-CROWD-QUIET
variants.falsification: cell nearly empty (n=6) with wrong sign; no evidence of superior quiet-regime carry

variants.name: CARRY-DD-STOP
variants.gate: FAIL (predeclared: >=50 stop events on dev; observed 11)
variants.falsification: stop triggers too rare to constitute an operable overlay; favorable metrics are an artifact of being ~92% always-on during a positive-carry era, not an exploitable conditional signal; selection rule (predeclared) requires the gate, so it was not selected

variants.name: CONFLUENCE
variants.rule: pos=-1 if f_pctl>=0.99 & rv_pctl>=0.40 & f_pctl_prev>=0.90; else 0
variants.falsification: t=+1.96<3.0 in absolute value and opposite sign; n=48<50

variants.name: TAIL-LONG-SHORT-DIR
variants.rule: pos=-1 if f_pctl>=0.99 & rv_pctl>=0.40; +1 if f_pctl<=0.15 & rv_pctl<0.40; else 0 (perp)
variants.falsification: perp8 tail t=+0.96 vs mid: no directional predictive content in either tail; n=61<80; per-symbol signs inconsistent (BTC -0.23, ETH +1.55)

key_conditional_evidence_development.interpretation: both tested tails violate the predeclared thesis: high funding precedes ABOVE-average carry (funding persistence), low funding precedes BELOW-average carry; spot/perp return tails carry no exploitable directional signal over 8-24h

validation.note: no variant was selected on development data, so the protocol's one frozen validation comparison does not exist; returns.csv contains the REJECTED flagship V1 exhibit vs its benchmark for the blind evaluator only

verification.self_check: PASS (TrailingRank strictly-trailing semantics + variant rule spot checks)
